children: Rent the Runway entered into a Third Amendment to its Amended and Restated Credit Agreement to add a $10 million incremental term loan facility. Proceeds will be used for working capital and other general corporate purposes. The amendment is with CHS (US) Management as administrative agent and the lenders party to the facility, enhancing the company's liquidity and financial flexibility.
